THE SOUL
OF AN ICON.
The Lancer gave birth to the Lancer Evolution over 12 years ago. It proved that performance was not the sole property of the super rich. We proved smaller
engines could beat gas guzzling behemoths. When the Lancer Evolution was introduced, the world took notice and an icon was born. Today, that challenging
spirit continues. Today’s Lancer delivers a combination of performance and style no other car can match.
